description: GitHub's own workflow parser, before and after the C4 correction. Recorded from authenticated read-only GitHub REST calls; no workflow was dispatched and no hosted phase was run.

signal.why: The workflow declares workflow_dispatch only. A push therefore cannot legitimately start it, so an instantaneous zero-job push-event workflow run naming the file is GitHub reporting that the file failed validation, and the absence of one is GitHub accepting the file.
signal.corroboration: Across the workflow's entire 73-run history the only push-event runs are the two at the rejected candidate. Every other run is workflow_dispatch.

annotationRetrieval.detail: The run has zero jobs and its check suite has zero check runs, so the Checks annotations API has no anchor to read from. GraphQL is not served for this session and the github.com HTML surface that renders the banner is refused by the session's repository-scoped API policy. The error was therefore derived locally and confirmed against GitHub's parser instead.

correction.minimum: delete the one unmatched closing parenthesis on line 135
correction.shipped: the chained expression was replaced outright by the C5 exact mode map, which has no default and therefore no `|| 'preflight'` tail; the minimum fix was proved against GitHub's parser first, on its own diagnostic commit
correction.environmentSecretsInsideAReusableWorkflo: UNCHANGED AND STILL SUPPORTED. The job-level `environment:` in the called workflow is the mechanism that supplies HOSTED_STRIPE_TEST_SECRET and HOSTED_STRIPE_TEST_WEBHOOK_SECRET, which are declared in no workflow_call secrets block and forwarded by no caller. Nothing about that architecture was altered: the validation error was a parenthesis, not a secrets model. actionlint flags those two expressions because it cannot model environment secrets; GitHub's parser accepts them, as the runs above show.

knownValidatorModelGaps.finding: property "workflow_sha" / "workflow_ref" / "workflow_repository" / "workflow_file_path" is not defined in object type {check_run_id: number; container: ...}
knownValidatorModelGaps.reality: These are the documented `job` context workflow-identity properties. actionlint v1.7.12 models the job context as {check_run_id, container, services, status} and does not yet carry them. GitHub's parser accepts them.
knownValidatorModelGaps.suppressedWith: .github/actionlint.yaml — four patterns, each naming ONE property and anchored on that object type, scoped to .github/workflows/rcap-hosted-acceptance-staging.yml alone
knownValidatorModelGaps.negativeControl: scripts/control/fixtures/actionlint-negative-control.yml proves a misspelled job property, and these same four names at any other path, are still reported

knownValidatorModelGaps.finding: property "hosted_stripe_test_secret" / "hosted_stripe_test_webhook_secret" is not defined in object type secrets
knownValidatorModelGaps.reality: Environment-scoped secrets supplied only by the job-level rcap-acceptance-payment GitHub Environment, deliberately absent from on.workflow_call.secrets. actionlint cannot model environment secrets for a reusable workflow's job-level environment. Removing them would dismantle the Stripe privilege boundary.
knownValidatorModelGaps.suppressedWith: .github/actionlint.yaml — two patterns, each naming ONE secret, scoped to the hosted called workflow alone
knownValidatorModelGaps.negativeControl: the fixture proves an unrelated undefined secret, and these two names at any other path, are still reported

confirmedOnCorrectionBranch.note: The implementation commit itself, not only the diagnostic branch, is accepted by GitHub's workflow parser.

f1Correction.finding: The C7 gate compared a workflow-SHA property on the `github` context that GitHub does not define. It resolved to the empty string, the comparison was written to skip on empty, and the gate therefore asserted nothing while printing that caller and callee agreed.

correctedContract.github.workflow_sha: the workflow in the github context; inside a reusable workflow it stays associated with the CALLER
correctedContract.job.workflow_sha: the commit of the workflow file defining the current job

calledGate: job.workflow_ref contains the repository and the workflow path and ends at the authorized execution ref
